title: Understanding Finance
description:
Anyone can take a finance class, memorize a bunch of formulas and rules, and then check off the box that they took the class.  My goal however in all of these lectures is to maximize your understanding and not your ability to memorize.

On this channel, I will have provided both "understanding finance nuggets" as well as the lectures for three classes: Corporate Finance, Advanced Corporate Finance, and International Finance. All three of these classes include "building block" lectures meaning you will likely get more out of the experience if you watch them in order and do not move on to lecture 3 until you understand lecture 4.

The "understanding finance nuggets" are mini-lectures on narrow topics. In some cases the "nugget" can be understood on a "stand-alone" basis, and in other instances I will provide information on  "required" or "desired" pre-requisite nuggets.
